t: After an update, the latest changes stay visible as info: green banner at the top until you tap OK, and always under System → Update
Ride player: new tiles LiDAR distance and AUTO steering/throttle (what the Core steers when following or in shadow mode)
Drift & Auto: Follow a ride – the Core drives a recorded or virtual ride by itself (MSP RC Override), with shadow mode
Optional LiDAR distance sensor (e.g. MicoAir MT-15): brakes in AUTO, distance saved in every ride
Virtual rides: smooth track without jitter or zig-zag, car stands still when stopped, smoother attitude
Virtual rides faster and adjustable: top speed, corner speed, acceleration, styles gentle/normal/wild/custom, average speed shown; Close button left
Drift page shows only rides with drift data
Player: Web page button returns to the page you came from, page remembers the open tab, Drift page skips old rides without drift data
Buttons: channel overview incl. INAV modes read from the FC (Arm, AUTO, ...) and the msp_override_channels value
Tab bar: tap pencil to drag tabs into a new order and hide pages, hidden pages under the dots button
Saved guest Wi-Fi networks with passwords in the settings backup (Core Backup / file), import ride CSV (optionally as demo, never counted)
Wi-Fi page: tap a network to connect until switched off (friend, restaurant), saved networks; battery/undervoltage card moved to Battery

Wi-Fi fix (connects even if the scan fails), roaming to a stronger access point, own pages Wi-Fi (networks around) and Drift & Auto, virtual rides: saving fixed, buttons at the bottom, Cancel, browser back
Drift detection in rides, MSP RC override (autonomous, test mode)
System: PC backup status (last run, result, folder, PC)
Virtual rides: draw on the map, laid onto paths, own list
Phone hotspot first, search every 4 s
Faster connect to phone hotspot: looks for available networks first
Rides without time get date and name as soon as the clock is set
Clock on display, NO TIME shown until the clock is set
Date and time from FC GPS, works without internet
Reset history per battery
My batteries shows only the set number of batteries
Battery number channel moved to Buttons
Clearer label for the battery number channel
Battery list: number of batteries, description and capacity per battery
Undervoltage in two stages: early OSD warning every 3 s, then full alarm
Amps: real FC current plus calculated ESC current
Standstill current from FC plus extra load
Battery number: select by transmitter channel, shown in OSD and display
Same width for switches and number fields
FC mounting reduced to Attitude = level
System: save settings to file and restore from file or SD card
Random hotspot password is shown on USB for boards without display
High beam flash fixed, now flashes 3 times
Double click flashes high beam, long press turns it off and back to the last level
4S test batteries are no longer logged or counted
Battery page: summary per battery, numbered by order of the day
Learning starts after 30 s disarmed instead of 60 s
New Battery page: battery now, what the Core learned, list of batteries used
Resistance is learned separately for 4S and 6S
Current estimate learns only when disarmed, after 60 s at rest
Amps without a current sensor: estimated from voltage sag, learns per battery
Amps shown in the OSD and saved in rides
Battery percent follows a LiPo curve, no longer a straight line
Blue channel fields on the Buttons page
Narrower settings pages on PC, OSD cards one below the other
Sensors: each value on its own row
Map download pause text only when a download runs
PC: fields sit right next to their labels
Settings pages back to one column
New layout: settings pages in two columns on PC
Telemetry sections fold open and closed with a short summary
Explanations moved behind an info button
Same on/off look everywhere
Buttons: channel field of the switches on the right, same as the buttons
Online update is locked while the car is armed
Maps: Coordinates or map link now sits directly above its input field
OSD: new switch Positions from INAV, the Core then sends texts only
OSD preview uses the real 53 x 20 grid of INAV with DJI native
OSD: drag each text in the preview to place it, like in INAV
OSD: each temperature can be switched on or off by itself
OSD page rebuilt: compact switches, position with pictures, preview next to settings
REC text removed from the OSD
Menu order: drag the tabs instead of using arrows
Phone: values in one column, no line breaks
Phone: memory bars show their full text
Wider page on PC with two columns
Wi-Fi: signal in dBm next to the rating, channel on its own row
New value: Armed today
Button to reset armed total
Long values wrap to a second line instead of being cut off
Online update shows what's new before you update
GPS coordinates in Loaded areas
Coordinates button checks that copying worked
All coordinates with 6 decimals
'recognized' only shown for links
Hold a photo (or right-click) to show it large
Tap a photo or 'No photo' to add or replace it
Camera button removed
Empty space at the bottom of every page, so the phone keyboard covers nothing
Ride list: places always on one line
Rides: export selected as ZIP
